verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for a web framework, so the axis applies. No item in the evidence pack mentions Next.js's license, an open-source repository, or public source code. Self-hosting docs and a third-party reimplementation are adjacent topics and do not show the product's source is openly licensed.
